synthesis:draft.headline: Five‑minute RRP peaked at 845.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST (interval end 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z).
summary: The 5-minute RRP peaked at 845.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST (2026-07-29T07:55:00Z).
There were 26 five-minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh in the window.

Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at interval end 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z was 1964.83 MW; the half-hour operational demand for the half-hour ending 2026-07-29T08:00:00Z was 1872.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand was 2144.0 MW.

The PDPASA Forecast LOR1 notice (market_notice_144652) gives 0700 hrs 29/07/2026 (2026-07-29 06:30 ACST, 2026-07-28T21:00:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

The PDPASA cancellation notice (market_notice_144655) gives 1345 hrs 28/07/2026 (2026-07-28 13:15 ACST, 2026-07-28T03:45:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

The STPASA Forecast LOR2 notice (market_notice_144627) gives From 1600 hrs to 1630 hrs 29/07/2026 (UTC 2026-07-29T06:00:00Z to 2026-07-29T06:30:00Z; local 2026-07-29 15:30 ACST to 2026-07-29 16:00 ACST), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

The STPASA cancellation notice (market_notice_144628) gives 1200 hrs 27/07/2026 (2026-07-27 11:30 ACST, 2026-07-27T02:00:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

possible_explanations.statement: The 845.0 $/MWh dispatch price for interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z may reflect high-priced offers or rebids binding in the five-minute dispatch for that interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Fetch rebid and offer records for interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z and check whether high-priced offers or rebids were present and binding in SA1.

possible_explanations.statement: The spike might be associated with a sudden generator withdrawal or trip (examples in the generation-change observations include the ~192.54 MW increase at BARKIPS [ev1471] and the -85.27 MW change at BNGSF2 [ev1486]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review unit outage logs and SCADA trip reports for BARKIPS, BNGSF2 and other units that changed output in the 06:00–10:00 UTC window and check for trips or availability changes around interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: A network constraint or local limitation could have reduced effective supply despite forecasts and notices such as the PDPASA Forecast LOR1 [c1]; this could make available capacity lower than forecast in dispatch.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect constraint binding reports and dispatch constraint notices that apply to SA1 for interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z to see if any constraint was binding.
